Answer: C
Reason: The sequential chest X-rays demonstrate rapidly evolving, bilateral diffuse alveolar opacities (Figure 1 and 3) that show significant resolution by day 4 (Figure 4a), a pattern characteristic of Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) responding to mechanical ventilation and supportive care. Pneumonia typically resolves more slowly, and cardiogenic edema usually presents with cardiomegaly which is not prominent here.
